scripts.dev: concurrently -n "shared,server,client" -c "blue,green,magenta" "npm run build:watch --workspace=packages/shared" "npm run dev --workspace=packages/server" "npm run dev --workspace=packages/client"

scripts.test: npm run test --workspace=packages/shared && npm run test --workspace=packages/server
